title: Leopold Sulerzhitsky
text: Leopold Antonovich Sulerzhitsky (Russian: Леопольд Антонович Сулержицкий; 27 September 1872 – 30 December 1916) was a Russian theatre director, painter and pedagogue of Polish descent. He is associated with the Moscow Art Theatre and the household of Leo Tolstoy. Among his many students were Yevgeny Vakhtangov and Michael Chekhov.
